placeholders.title: Gene-to-Pathway Interpretation
placeholders.description: Starts from a deliberately overwhelming list of fictional differentially expressed genes. Buttons progressively sort by fold change, filter by statistical evidence, group by pathway, collapse into biological functions, and surface a possible mechanistic interpretation — with an optional demo of how an inappropriate background gene set can produce a misleadingly strong enrichment result.

placeholders.title: Biomarker Panel Builder
placeholders.description: Students select genes from a candidate panel to build a predictive signature, see training accuracy, sensitivity/specificity, a confusion matrix, and an ROC curve — then find out how the panel performs on a hidden test set, with a challenge to build the smallest panel that still generalizes.

placeholders.title: Mechanistic Network Explorer
placeholders.description: A small molecular network where students can activate a receptor, inhibit a kinase, knock down a transcription factor, or block a feedback loop and watch downstream nodes update — designed to make the distinction between correlation, known regulation, and inferred causation concrete.

placeholders.title: Match-the-Mechanism Puzzle
placeholders.description: Draggable evidence pieces (exposure, target binding, transcriptomic signature, pathway enrichment, histopathology, cell-type response, spatial location, dose-response behavior — some of them distractors) get arranged into an evidence chain, with feedback on what supports association, mechanism, or causality, and what's insufficient on its own.

placeholders.title: Sequencing Method Selection Challenge
placeholders.description: Given a fictional research question, students choose among bulk RNA-seq, single-cell/single-nucleus RNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, a targeted panel, long-read sequencing, ATAC-seq, or multi-omics, and allocate a limited relative budget across animals, cells, depth, resolution, and conditions to see what each design can and can't answer.

placeholders.title: Sequencing Pipeline Assembly
placeholders.description: Draggable pipeline blocks, from biological question through validation, get placed in order (with branching where appropriate), plus hidden failure cards — batch confounded with treatment, poor RNA quality, too few replicates, wrong reference genome, cell-composition change, data leakage, an inappropriate statistical threshold — that students must place at the right pipeline stage.

placeholders.title: Annotation and Classification Game
placeholders.description: Students label fictional samples one at a time from a small expression profile, a simple browser-based classifier trains on those labels, gets tested on new examples, and the activity shows how inconsistent or biased labeling degrades performance — with the ability to correct labels and retrain.
